name: Park Hyatt New York
positioning: Midtown Manhattan hotel in the One57 building, across from Carnegie Hall, with a spa and indoor saltwater pool on the 25th floor
best_for: Travelers who want a Midtown base across from Carnegie Hall
Guests who want a spa with an indoor saltwater pool, eucalyptus steam room and hot tub
Families who need connecting rooms, and travelers bringing a dog

facts.text: The hotel is in Midtown Manhattan, across from Carnegie Hall.
The hotel is in the One57 building in Midtown.
Each room and suite features museum-quality artwork, floor-to-ceiling windows, designer linens and heated floors.
Rooms have Le Labo bath amenities.
The hotel spa features an indoor saltwater pool, a eucalyptus steam room and a hot tub.
The Rossano Ferretti HairSpa is on the 8th floor of the hotel.
The fitness center is next to the pool area and overlooks the greenery of Central Park.
The Living Room Restaurant & Bar is the hotel's restaurant on 57th Street.
Rooms and suites include several options for connecting rooms and amenities for babies and kids.
The hotel is pet friendly, with a pet bed, dog bowl with water and treats in the room.

highlights.text: The indoor saltwater pool has underwater speakers that play specially selected music.
The indoor saltwater spa pool is on the 25th floor.
Spa Nalai is the first exclusive KOS PARIS spa in New York City.
The Manhattan Suite sits in a private wing on the hotel's top floor.
The Central Park Balcony Suite can connect to the Manhattan Suite and another Central Park Balcony Suite to form a three-bedroom suite.

considerations.text: Self-parking is at the Icon Parking garage on West 58th Street, which has direct hotel access.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy Midtown area with high foot traffic.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
